title: bug: strict-consumer dependency messages still say DONE/ARCHIVED, and decideCheckRepair's doc overclaims late-observation filtering
description:
Found by CQ-V12's whole-epic review (task-b621ddc9, worker-0e1ab990, 2026-11-01). This is text only.
- The structured readiness is correct: isDependencySatisfied, unmetDependsOn, satisfiedBlockedOnIds and dependsOnUnmet all take the consumer, and the V12b dependencyProjection fixtures pass.
- No gate is affected. The gap is latent until verified-local is enabled.

1) tools/reportBlocked.ts:499-507. heldOnEvidence lists only DONE ids, and blockResolution says "auto-unblocks … once <ids> are DONE/ARCHIVED". For a verified-local consumer, two kinds of id never unblock, and neither is described:
   - an ARCHIVED prerequisite without its delivery receipt (delivery-receipt);
   - a deleted id (prerequisite-missing).
2) None of these texts says a verified-local consumer needs retained verified delivery, or that a missing id never satisfies it:
   - tools/claimNextTask.ts:261 "(dependsOn gates WORKING claims until they are DONE/ARCHIVED)";
   - the tools/setTaskDependencies.ts:30 description and the :141-142 messages ("already DONE/ARCHIVED", "until they are DONE/ARCHIVED");
   - the tools/reportBlocked.ts tool and blockedOnTaskIds descriptions.
3) delivery/repairActivation.ts:26-32. decideCheckRepair's doc says "a late or replayed observation never acts", but only a decision carrying diagnostics is matched to the latest run (line 52).
   - A late run on the current candidate still returns none or replan.
   - This is benign: replan follows the task's plan revision, not the run, and an observation marker allows one answer per dispatch.
   - Fix the comment, not the behaviour.

Failing-test sketch: a strict consumer is blocked on an ARCHIVED prerequisite with no receipt (spy assertExecutionProfileReady as state/dependencyReadiness.strict.test.ts does). Expect blockResolution to name that id through describeUnmetDependency (…missing delivery-receipt). It does not today.
definitionOfDone: report_blocked's blockResolution names every recorded blockedOnTaskId the consumer-aware predicate withholds (DONE, ARCHIVED or missing) via describeUnmetDependency

The claim refusal, set_task_dependencies and report_blocked messages and tool descriptions state the verified-local rule (retained verified delivery; a missing prerequisite never satisfies) while legacy/observe wording stays accurate
decideCheckRepair's doc comment matches its actual filter; cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test passes
reopenReason: Governor promotion (human delegation; the user's "move from backlog whts needed"). This is text only, but it is latent until verified-local is enabled, and CQ-M07 is the row that enables it. So CQ-M07 (task-1a8f1d0e) now dependsOn this row. File order: claimNextTask.ts is also declared by CQ-M07q (task-bb1502b1, parked on its size waiver) and edited by 4e2f2b45. Add dependsOn on both so the edits don't contest.
